v3.0 lacked a bundled verification script inside scripts/; v3.1 bundled scripts/validate_artifact.py (PEP 723, non-interactive JSON stdout).
Baseline produced a single monolithic system prompt with adjective traits; v3.1 deduplicated Mode C instructions in SKILL.md (-20.6% chars) and routed cleanly to references/agent_role_adapters.md.

v3_0_failures: t04 (Val/Train miss): English query mentioning SOUL.md and Hub-and-Spoke AGENTS.md under-triggered because v3.0 description lacked explicit file-level tokens (SOUL.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursor/rules/).
t09 (Val miss): Query asking to compile React rules into .cursor/rules/ and GitHub Copilot custom agent under-triggered.
n02 & n03 (False positives): Near-miss queries asking for FastMCP Python SDK code or Ubuntu systemd service for openclaw daemon falsely triggered because DO NOT TRIGGER boundary was too generic.
